    Profile

    Lachesis is the second of Soren's creations after Atropos, possessing a humanoid form closer to that of a teenager. Bestowed with the ability to control and manipulate organic matter, Lachesis revels in the gift of life, following Soren around the world to heal sickness and disease. Her curiosity and compassion for humans knows no bounds. Lachesis waits patiently for the day she can explore this wonderful world once more with her master, and bring an age of happiness to all.
